instruction: Access webext.eu to create a Chrome extension template with the name "page-capture v0.5.0". Don't include a description, add both a background script and browser action feature, and unpack the generated file to "~/Projects".

metadata.explanation: Task variation 3: Creates a Chrome extension named 'page-capture v0.5.0' using webext.eu. Evaluator validates manifest.json structure (name, version, background scripts, browser_action) and verifies all required files exist (manifest.json, background_script.js, browserAction files). Score: 50% for file existence + 50% for manifest structure validation.
